raw_result.summary: Plan-only ACCEPT. The six pinned artifact hashes and unchanged source HEAD were verified; deterministic explicit implementation-design validation returned zero errors. I compared ordered raw plan reviews 01–14 and definition reviews 01–12 with the current raw artifacts. Earlier PATH trust, launch ordering, partial-open cleanup, settings test seam, disposition authority, ownership transition, Web composition and task-routing findings remain resolved; no new plan-owned defect was found. The new I09/I10/S08/T08/X05/C07 decisions specify an exact trusted binding producer, source-correct lookup of the existing ownership record, host-protected metadata, one active process owner, and a shared grant-close and resource-settlement handoff without widening Story 18.1's public read capability or assigning Story 18.3's native child implementation to 18.2. The named mutex does not prove crash settlement; a persisted Ready record remains unavailable after restart until independent prior-generation child and handle settlement is established. Missing operator admission, selected-host protection, 18.3 settlement facts and restricted native JDT qualification are explicit fail-closed prerequisites, not accepted runtime results. Architecture classification and AGENTS.md planned-change authorization remain required after this review; this verdict grants no approval, resource permission or native readiness. Historical tasks were excluded, so complete SpecKit task analysis and design-ID task coverage await corrected tasks.
